bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
stage=deploy/state/notice-pr81-926f30bb
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
target=926f30bbee7203f1dffbf534aaa4f587c1e25be6
old_sha=2caa2d82fd6749dcf08ba7f2cd60dd0cf70dee43ffcd8d639752c3c8c74b7f69
new_sha=22c930f364bcec223a0a3ddca9d04dbadf74d1bc4cffe4d08494ef8e1a4311b7
localtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-926f30bb
rollback_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-notice-926f30bb
test -s "$stage/checkpoint.json"
test ! -e "$stage/live.json"
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$target"
for run in 46039623006 46039623100 46039623084 46039623325; do
 test "$(gh run view "$run" -R "$repo" --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$target success"
done
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
export old_image old_sha new_image new_sha target stage
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,pathlib
j=json.loads((pathlib.Path(os.environ["stage"])/"checkpoint.json").read_text())
for k in ("old_image","old_sha","new_image","new_sha"):assert j[k]==os.environ[k],k
assert j["source_sha"]==os.environ["target"]
PY
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$localtag")" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config -q
if docker image inspect "$rollback_tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback_tag")" = "$old_image"; else docker tag "$old_image" "$rollback_tag"; fi
printf 'MENU_TEST_BEFORE_DEPLOY\n'
if python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu; then echo MENU_BEFORE=PASS; else echo MENU_BEFORE=FAIL; fi
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback_tag" "$localtag"
  if docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then echo NOTICE_ROLLBACK_RECREATED; else echo NOTICE_ROLLBACK_RECREATE_FAILED >&2; fi
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
docker tag "$candidate" "$localtag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -F 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' >/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 3
done
test "$ready" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Restarting}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$new_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = 1000:1000:600
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -ec 'dwebp -version >/dev/null'
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
printf '{"source_sha":"%s","image":"%s","bundle_sha":"%s","rollback_image":"%s","state":"RUNTIME_VERIFIED"}\n' "$target" "$new_image" "$new_sha" "$old_image" > "$stage/live.json"
ok=1
echo NOTICE_PUBLICATION_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY=PASS
echo USERBOT_AND_POSTGRES_UNCHANGED=PASS
printf 'MENU_TEST_AFTER_DEPLOY\n'
if python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu; then echo MENU_AFTER=PASS; else echo MENU_AFTER=FAIL; fi
docker logs --tail 400 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import sys,collections,re
s=sys.stdin.read()
for k,v in sorted(collections.Counter(re.findall(r"\[GAYBBS_ERROR\]\s+(\w+)\s+(\w+)",s)).items()):print("BOT_ERROR",*k,v)
for k in ["GAYBBS_BOT_READY","POST_PUBLICATION_FAILED","409:","401:","429:","Bad Request","ETELEGRAM","ETIMEDOUT"]:print("LOG_COUNT",k,s.count(k))'
